verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a generic Events API for recording pageviews/custom events usable from mobile or server-side apps, plus a script tag for web, but there's no evidence of official SDKs/libraries for specific languages (e.g., Swift, Kotlin, Node, Python) beyond raw HTTP API and script snippet. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), official backend language SDKs, community/hands-on confirmation of SDK usage.
